layout.title: Cookie Policy
layout.intro: How cookies and similar technologies are used on this website.

sections.heading: What are cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small files stored on your device by a website. They help websites work and remember information about your visit.

sections.heading: Cookies we use
sections.body: This website does not use advertising cookies. Your browser may store small amounts of information needed for the website to work, such as display settings.

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.body:
Some pages include services from other companies that may set their own cookies:

  • Google Maps on our Contact page, to show our location;
  • WhatsApp and LinkedIn, if you follow links to them.

These services are covered by their own privacy and cookie policies.

sections.heading: Managing cookies
sections.body: You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Some parts of the website, such as the map, may not work fully if you do.
